I've replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines at 185 seats of Pemberline Dock. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01.

I also told her about Amendment No. 3, signed on 2026-09-22. It raises the count to 230 seats, but not until 2027-01-01, so 185 is still the current number for her QBR deck.

Seat counts and dates count as operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed. Dana is on the North team, which handles this account. Both amendments are North team contract pages, and I left out any prices or discounts.
